agents.reason: Dinos run the creature driver (ARK temperament, senses, follow and stay orders), not a needs-and-mood agent loop.

audio-probe.reason: Audio mix: The survival slice ships silent; ARK-style ambience and gather sounds come with an audio pass.

cover-field.reason: Fernwild has no gunfight cover: combat is melee and tranq shots at dinos in the open.

cover-points-from-solids.reason: No cover shooting in an ARK survival game; nothing derives cover points from solids.

cover-points-near.reason: No cover shooting in an ARK survival game; nothing looks up nearby cover.

cover-score.reason: No cover shooting in an ARK survival game; cover is never scored.

cover-select.reason: No cover shooting in an ARK survival game; nobody picks cover.

damage-runtime.reason: Hits are flat ARK damage onto the health stat; no damage table, hit zones or armor until the armor pass.

damage-target-unknown.reason: No damage table, so there is no resistance profile for a hit to miss.

equipment-slot-inventory.reason: Equipment slots: Cloth armor is craftable but worn armor slots come with the armor pass; the slice uses inventory and hotbar only.

game-save.reason: Progress saves through the survivor system's snapshot module and the shell's manual save; no separate save document yet.

game-save-digest.reason: The survivor snapshot module is the whole save in this slice; there is no save document to digest.

loan-schedule.reason: ARK has no banks or loans; nothing is borrowed on the island.

loans.reason: ARK has no banks or loans; nothing is borrowed on the island.

loot-comparison.reason: Loot rolling: No rolled gear with stats yet; supply drops and their loot tables come with the late-game PR.

loot-generation.reason: No loot rolling yet; resource yields come from fixed harvest ranges, drops arrive later.

loot-roller.reason: Loot rolling: Gathering yields fixed ARK ranges per node, not loot rolls; supply drops come later.

loot-score.reason: Loot rolling: No rolled items to score in the survival slice.

loot-validation.reason: Loot rolling: No loot tables exist yet to validate; supply drops add them.

mission-events.reason: Mission runtime: ARK is sandbox survival with no missions; progression is levels and engrams.

mission-rewards.reason: Mission runtime: ARK is sandbox survival with no missions; rewards are XP and engram points.

mission-runtime.reason: Mission runtime: ARK is sandbox survival with no mission system.

mission-validation.reason: Mission runtime: ARK is sandbox survival with no missions to validate.

nav-crowd.reason: No navigation crowd: dinos steer straight at their goal and veer around trunks and rocks.

nav-runtime.reason: No navigation mesh to route on yet: dinos steer locally around solids.

navmesh-from-scene.reason: No navigation mesh is baked from the island; creatures steer locally around solids.

near-agents.reason: No agent loop: creatures are driven one by one by the creature driver, with no needs-driven residents.

offscreen-world.reason: Offscreen simulation: The island is one live scene; nothing simulates offscreen in the survival slice.

police-response.reason: Police heat: A prehistoric island has no police or wanted level.

police-roads.reason: Police heat: A prehistoric island has no roads or police patrols.

ride-appeal.reason: Ride simulation: Riding is dino saddles, not theme-park rides; no ride appeal model applies.

ride-choice.reason: Ride simulation: No theme-park rides on the island; dino riding uses possession.

ride-sim.reason: No theme-park ride simulation; dino riding uses possession with saddles.

rvo-avoidance.reason: No crowd steering: herds are two or three animals that steer around solids, not around each other.

session-loop.reason: ARK is an endless sandbox with no rounds or runs; the island persists.

skill-tree.reason: ARK progression is the engram list unlocked by level and engram points, built on unlock points, not a skill tree.

squad-combat.reason: No squad combat: tamed dinos follow, stay and fight their owner's fight through the companion roster.

status-runtime.reason: No status effects yet: torpor and narcotics are knockout taming's meters; hunger, thirst, heat and cold are survivor vitals flags.

status-unknown.reason: Status effects: Status in the slice is vitals flags only; no status table exists to reference unknown ids.

supply-demand-pricing.reason: Market pricing: No traders or market on the island; nothing is bought or sold.

traffic.reason: A prehistoric island has no road traffic.

transaction-ledger.reason: Transaction ledger: No currency in ARK; resources move only between inventories.

utility-brain.reason: No agent loop: ARK creatures act on their temperament (creature-temperament), not on need appeal.

vehicle-damage.reason: Vehicle damage: No vehicles on the island; dinos are mounts with health, not vehicles.

visitor-population.reason: Park population: No park visitors; the island's population is dinosaurs.

wait-queue.reason: No queues of people; the crafting queue is the survivor's own work queue.

weapon-system.reason: No weapon runtime yet: only melee tools and the club; slingshot, bow and tranq arrows join a later PR.
